name: What accessibility features can be added during a shower conversion?

mainEntity.name: What accessibility features can be added during a shower conversion?

acceptedAnswer.text: To make a walk-in shower safer and more accessible, you can incorporate a low-profile or barrier-free zero-threshold entry curb to prevent tripping. Adding secure backing behind the walls allows for the installation of sturdy grab bars. Other functional improvements include slip-resistant textured floor tiles, a built-in tiled bench or floating seat, and a handheld shower wand mounted alongside the primary showerhead to simplify seated bathing.
acceptedAnswer.description: You can include low-threshold or curb-free entries, slip-resistant floor tile, internal wall blocking for grab bars, handheld sprayers, and built-in seating.
